# Prompt a Tool – full content

> Prompt a Tool is a free web app that turns an app idea into tailored development prompts, user roles, AI agents and skills. URL: https://prompt-a-tool.com/

## How it works

1. Describe your app idea in plain language.
2. Answer a few AI-generated follow-up questions so the tool understands your needs.
3. Get a complete set of user roles, AI agents, backend prompts and frontend prompts tailored to your project.

## What you get

- User roles: the types of users and what they can do in your app
- AI agents: smart helpers that perform tasks and use tools in your app
- Backend prompts: instructions for building the server and database
- Frontend prompts: instructions for building the user interface

## Features

- AI-generated follow-up questions
- Export as Markdown, JSON or AGENTS.md
- Shareable links
- Save and revisit prompts when signed in
- Nine languages: English, French, Arabic (right-to-left), Portuguese, Swahili, Hausa, Yoruba, Amharic, Luganda
- Installable PWA with offline support

## FAQ

### What is Prompt a Tool?
Prompt a Tool is a free web app that turns an app idea into a complete set of user roles, AI agents, backend prompts and frontend prompts, so you can start building with an AI coding assistant faster.

### How does Prompt a Tool work?
You describe your app idea in plain language, answer a few AI-generated follow-up questions, and receive tailored prompts for your project. You can then export them as Markdown, JSON or an AGENTS.md file.

### Is Prompt a Tool free?
Yes. Prompt a Tool is free to use and does not require an account to generate prompts. Signing in lets you save and revisit your prompts.

### Which languages does Prompt a Tool support?
English, French, Arabic (right-to-left), Portuguese, Swahili, Hausa, Yoruba, Amharic and Luganda.

### Does Prompt a Tool work offline?
Yes. It is a Progressive Web App that can be installed and opened offline. Generating new prompts needs a connection because the AI runs on the server.
